6.direction_hint: Head west for about 25 m. Bear left and walk southwest for about 25 m. Bear right and walk west for about 45 m, passing Mabini Hall on your left. Turn right and walk north for about 25 m, passing El Filibusterismo Hall on your left. Bear left and walk northwest for about 25 m. Bear right and walk north for about 15 m, passing Noli Me Tangere Hall on your left. Turn right and walk northeast for about 30 m, until you reach Gregorio Zara Hall.

9.direction_hint: Head south for about 100 m, until you reach Mabini Hall at its back entrances.
9.reverse_hint: Head north for about 100 m, until you reach CBEAM Hall.

10.direction_hint: Head north for about 15 m. Bear left and walk northwest for about 30 m, until you reach Noli Me Tangere Hall. This way uses the connecting corridor between the two halls.
10.reverse_hint: Head southeast for about 30 m. Bear right and walk south for about 15 m, until you reach El Filibusterismo Hall. This way uses the connecting corridor between the two halls.

11.direction_hint: Head east for about 15 m. Bear right and walk southeast for about 50 m, passing El Filibusterismo Hall on your left, until you reach Mabini Hall at its ramp entrance. This way uses the ramp between Noli and Fili Hall.
11.reverse_hint: Head northwest for about 50 m, passing El Filibusterismo Hall on your right. Bear left and walk west for about 15 m, until you reach the Student Center. This way uses the ramp between Noli and Fili Hall.

13.direction_hint: Head southeast for about 55 m. Bear left and walk east for about 20 m. Bear left and walk northeast for about 40 m, passing the Hacienda on your right, until you reach St. Mutien Marie Hall at its south entrance.
13.reverse_hint: Head southwest for about 40 m, passing the Hacienda on your left. Bear right and walk west for about 20 m. Bear right and walk northwest for about 55 m, until you reach Claro M. Recto Hall at its north entrance.

25.direction_hint: Head south for about 20 m. Turn right and walk west for about 45 m, until you reach Claro M. Recto Hall at its south entrance.
25.reverse_hint: Head east for about 45 m. Turn left and walk north for about 20 m, until you reach St. Br. Miguel Hall.

28.direction_hint: Head north for about 20 m. Turn right and walk east for about 20 m. Turn left and walk north for about 55 m. Turn right and walk southeast for about 35 m, passing BB Hall (St. Br. Benilde) on your left, until you reach Feldgrau Pay Parking at its school entrance. This way goes around the buildings.
28.reverse_hint: Head northwest for about 35 m, passing BB Hall (St. Br. Benilde) on your right. Turn left and walk south for about 55 m. Turn right and walk west for about 20 m. Turn left and walk south for about 20 m, until you reach Br. Vernon Mabile Hall. This way goes around the buildings.

30.direction_hint: Head west for about 80 m. Turn right and walk north for about 35 m, until you reach BB Hall (St. Br. Benilde) at its main entrance.
30.reverse_hint: Head south for about 35 m. Turn left and walk east for about 80 m, until you reach the Side Gate.

33.direction_hint: Head west for about 45 m, passing St. Mutien Marie Hall on your left. Turn right and walk north for about 20 m. Turn left and walk west for about 40 m, until you reach the Capilla. This way follows the covered walkway south of Senten.
33.reverse_hint: Head east for about 40 m. Turn right and walk south for about 20 m. Turn left and walk east for about 45 m, passing St. Mutien Marie Hall on your right, until you reach the Senten Walkway Junction. This way follows the covered walkway south of Senten.

35.direction_hint: Head east past Diokno Hall. Turn left and walk north for about 35 m along its east side, then turn left to the College LRC.
35.reverse_hint: Head east from the College LRC. Turn right and walk south for about 35 m along Diokno Hall's east side, then turn right to Diokno Hall.

36.direction_hint: Head east for about 20 m. Turn left and walk north for about 60 m, until you reach Gen. M. Malvar.
36.reverse_hint: Head south for about 60 m. Turn right and walk west for about 20 m, until you reach the College LRC.

38.direction_hint: Head west for about 25 m. Turn right and walk north for about 45 m, until you reach the De La Salle Brothers' Novitiate.
38.reverse_hint: Head south for about 45 m. Turn left and walk east for about 25 m, until you reach the College LRC.

43.direction_hint: Head south for about 30 m. Turn right and walk west for about 50 m, until you reach Mabini Hall at its ramp entrance.
43.reverse_hint: Head east for about 50 m. Turn left and walk north for about 30 m, until you reach El Filibusterismo Hall.

44.direction_hint: Head south for about 105 m, until you reach the CBEAM Gate. This way follows the road.
44.reverse_hint: Head north for about 105 m, until you reach the Student Center. This way follows the road.
